name: Stackable Plastic Chair (custom color)
description: Reimagine your outdoor space with our elegant patio chair, a stylish addition that offers year-round dining luxury. Crafted from Glass Fiber Reinforced Polypropylene, these chairs are recyclable, eco-friendly, and built for lasting stability. Designed to resist UV, water, mildew, and rust, they are perfect for any weather. The stackable design saves space, and with no assembly required, each chair is ready to use upon arrival. Non-scratch leg caps protect your floors, combining function and comfort.
